gap: No result ChatGPT got states what the whole under-2-lb field costs at the makers' own stores today: the 1.3 lb Duex Plus DS starts at $183.99 at mobilepixels.us, below the $195.49 Staples and $199.99 Newegg Duex Lite cards ChatGPT showed, while the Xebec Snap that ChatGPT searched for starts at $609 at thexebec.com.
standout_why: Compared against thedadsneeze.com (in the results, not cited), the PCWorld Shop Duex Lite page (cited) and hosdocumentary.com; the cited mobilepixels.us pages returned HTTP 429 on every attempt and were not read. thedadsneeze already has a priced seven-row table with weights and already labels the Duex Plus DS the 'Lightest Laptop Screen Extender for Travel' at 1.3 lb, so the ranking is not new. What those pages lack is maker-store prices dated today, any Xebec or SideTrak row, the Duex Lite's sold-out and driver notes set beside the Plus DS, and a kit weight including cable and magnets.
decides: Confirms the pick; it does not change it. Duex Plus DS (ours) stays first at 1.3 lb and from $183.99 at the maker's store. Duex Lite ties on weight but has a smaller 12.5-inch screen, cost more on the card ChatGPT showed, and is sold out at PCWorld Shop. Duex Max DS (ours) is the larger-laptop row at 1.8 lb. Xebec Snap loses on price, at $609 or more. KOJOM, Tlscon and Orfibz undercut on price, but their weights are seller claims. Two limits: the store read gives the Duex DS 'from' price only, so the Max DS variant price was not re-read today, and thedadsneeze listed the Plus DS at $159.79 on Nov 20, which I could not re-check because Amazon was walled.
